$comment: The test stage, started from the start menu's Test stage button. Every field is explained in test-stage.md beside this file. As committed, China's three heroes against Byzantium's, on the Cyclops's Cave, a map with no obstacles or mountains, with Wait on (a Skip turn comes back after two thirds of a turn); the Priest with Invocation in place of Blessing (owner, 2026-10-31); and Byzantium's three as in a run since 2026-10-31 (owner): the Barbarian its tank, with Lunge and Fury, the Cataphract its damage hero, braced after each charge; and Lunge's Push 1 (owner, later 2026-10-31: the unit the Barbarian strikes Pushed 1 away from him). And the Magus with Alignment in place of Omen (owner, 2026-10-31): one of his six lines, any distance, through anything, the cards of every unit on it rearranged on the track, swapped among themselves and with Humphrey's; pick him on the start menu to play it.
